findings.title: Waterings list and dashboard 'Recent waterings' error states have no retry
findings.steps: Open /waterings (or the dashboard) while the API is down or failing, or open /waterings?bed=abc.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that re-fetches without reloading the page.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. There is no retry control. The dashboard doesn't even destructure refresh for waterings. With ?bed=abc the page shows the raw validation text 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'.
findings.evidence: SSR HTML of /waterings?bed=abc contains the raw message and no retry button. In the code, index.vue keeps only {data, error} from wateringsResult and waterings.vue never renders refresh in its error state.

findings.title: Retrying a watering after a timeout or failure creates duplicates (no idempotency)
findings.steps: Send the same POST /api/waterings twice, e.g. a retry after a slow response. Or, on the beds page, press Water now, let it fail on the client after the server committed, then press it again.
findings.expected: One watering per user intent. The retry should use an idempotency key or deduplicate.
findings.actual: Every request inserts a new row. Two concurrent identical POSTs created ids 3 and 4.
findings.evidence: Two parallel curl POSTs with identical bodies both returned 201 with different ids.

findings.title: New watering requests have no 10 s timeout
findings.where: Beds page Water now / Save watering, /waterings list and delete, dashboard
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never respond), then press 'Water now'.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s with a visible error, and the button is re-enabled.
findings.actual: useApiClient / useApiFetch set no timeout, so the button stays on 'Watering…' / 'Saving…' (disabled) and the list stays on 'Loading waterings…' for as long as the connection hangs.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: $fetch.create and useFetch have no timeout option, and the new code adds none.

findings.title: Huge integer bed_id / watering id gives a 500 instead of a 4xx
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (SQLite integer overflow). No upper bound on the int fields.
findings.evidence: All three requests returned 'Internal Server Error 500'.

findings.title: Bed list failure on the waterings page is silent; the filter shows no beds
findings.steps: Open /waterings while GET /api/beds fails but /api/waterings succeeds.
findings.expected: An error saying the beds could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is ignored, so the Bed dropdown just shows 'All beds' with no options and gives no reason.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: `const { data: beds } = bedsResult`. The error is never shown.

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted and shown as '0 L'
findings.steps: POST {"bed_id":1,"litres":1e-300} (or type 0.001 in the Litres field; the client only checks > 0).
findings.expected: Reject amounts below a sensible minimum (the input says min 0.1), or show the value accurately.
findings.actual: Saved with 201. formatLitres rounds to 2 decimals, so the watering shows as '0 L', and the total shows ', 0 L in total'.
findings.evidence: API returned litres 1e-300 with 201. formatLitres uses maximumFractionDigits: 2.

findings.title: Absurd past dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.expected: A visible refusal for implausible dates, or at least a lower bound.
findings.actual: Saved with 201 and shown as the bed's watering history entry.

findings.title: 'Today' can be refused as a future date when the browser's time zone is ahead of the server's
findings.steps: With the browser in a time zone ahead of the server (e.g. UTC+10 vs a UTC server, early morning), record a past watering with the default date (today).
findings.actual: The client defaults and caps the date to the browser's local today (todayIso), but the server validates against its own date.today(), so it returns 'Watering date cannot be in the future.'
findings.evidence: schemas.WateringIn.not_in_future uses date.today(); beds.vue uses todayIso() for the default and max.

findings.title: Long bed names in watering tables can cause sideways scrolling at 375 px
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name without spaces, water it, and view /waterings at 375 px wide.
findings.expected: The name wraps and the page fits 375 px.
findings.actual: The table cells have no overflow-wrap/word-break, and the table has 4 columns plus a nowrap amount column, so the table overflows horizontally.
findings.evidence: main.css has no overflow-wrap/word-break rules, and .table has no responsive handling.

findings.title: Deleting an already-deleted watering shows an error but leaves the stale row
findings.steps: Open /waterings in two tabs, delete a watering in one, then delete the same one in the other.
findings.expected: The list refreshes and the row disappears.
findings.actual: 'Watering not found.' is shown and the stale row stays until a reload.
findings.evidence: removeWatering only calls refresh() on success.
